event.title: Severe Flooding in Indiana Leads to Emergency Declaration and Multiple Deaths
event.canonical_title: Severe Flooding in Indiana Leads to Emergency Declaration and Multiple Deaths
event.summary: Severe weather and heavy rains have caused significant flooding across Indiana, resulting in at least six fatalities. President Trump has issued an emergency declaration to assist with relief efforts as many residents have been displaced. Rivers have reached record levels, prompting evacuations and ongoing threats of flooding throughout the state.
